scope: Human current-project metadata graph over existing governed local records
Independent endpoint/evidence visibility and frozen versions/hashes
Native Task/Review/Artifact and document/fact/span citation proofs
Private-origin isolation, transactional annotation/audit and durable replay
Task/Knowledge panels, candidate and explicit human annotations

related_regression.boundary: Relations, Memory governance/facts/forgetting/learning/context/search, native document import, Task commands/reviews.
related_regression.note: These runs precede the final snapshot-local metadata cache and equivalent owner-only citation short circuit. The affected relation suite was then rerun under both versions.

observed_semantic_red_cases: Frozen Fact document citation and native document backlinks
User/shared Memory ID collision in review cache
Unproven legacy links starving older frozen facts
Stored replay snapshot changed without its command hash
Legacy backlink ID outside the declared contract
